description: `runtime.adapters.<name>` merges key by key with the config file's own block, not whole-block replace: the document's `runtime.adapters.ollama.timeout_seconds` overrides just that key, and `config.json`'s own `base_url` survives untouched (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §8.6, orchestration-reference.md 'File Structure').
